newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman stocks higher, trading value soars.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks higher, trading value soars.

text.p: Shares on the Muscat stock exchange ended the week to Wednesday mostly higher and trading value doubled on the back of good buying interest for bank stocks, a report said.
The Muscat Securities Market share index closed at 184.15 points from 183.07 points the previous week.
Bank shares accounted for 77 percent of total trading value of 8.985 million rials, from 4.38 million rials last week.
Of the 59 companies traded in the week, 28 rose and 18 fell. Thirteen were unchanged.
National Bank of Oman lead the market, accounting for 44 percent of total trading value. The share price ended the week at 3.110, unchanged from the previous week.
Oman National Holding Co ended the week at 4.130 from 3.900 last week.
Dhofar Insurance Co ended the week lower at 1.850 from 1.950.
